title: Fix SRD ancestry trait line wrapping and table bleed
description:
Problem
The SRD importer mis-parses several ancestry traits when source text wraps across lines or when ancestry tables appear near trait prose.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Examples:
- Several ancestry records split Languages into fake trait names such as Common

LABELS: ingestion, rules, rules-pack

PARENT
  Γåæ Γùï eshyra-0m9: (EPIC) Build deterministic rules-pack ingestion pipeline ΓùÅ P1

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
notes: Fix implemented in PR #183 (branch fix/srd-ancestry-trait-wrapping-eshyra-0m9-15). Root cause: line-wrapped trait prose promoted to bogus traits + Dragonborn breath-weapon table bled into Speed. Fixed in parseAncestries.ts via sentence-complete guard before opening a new trait + breath-weapon table strip. 11 bogus traits removed, no kind/key churn; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack matches exactly; full suite green. Awaiting review/merge.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #183 (merged c2de130). Line-wrap fragment promotion + Dragonborn breath-weapon table bleed resolved in parseAncestries.ts; 11 bogus traits removed, no kind/key churn, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exact match.
